title: What he would do differently
summary: He would save money, slow down drinking and buy a farm in Georgia.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: My final question will be-- if you had it to do all over again, what would you do?
Save a whole lot of money.
He said what would you give up?
No, I'm saying you answered the question. You said you would save a whole lot of money. Anything else that you would like to ...
No, I don't know of nothing else I would give up. I love to drink and I'm drinking. But I would slow down on drinking, w-a-a-a-y down.
And you said you would save your money.
I'd save money and buy a home for my wife, maybe. But I wouldn't buy nothing in New York.
Where would you live? Would you go back to Decatur?

I may go back to Georgia. No, Buy a Farm. I'm not kidding. I like to relax. I like to have fun, relax, just quiet and enjoy yourself and I love to see... just beautiful ... I am having a beautiful time tonight because we are here and everybody is happy. Nobody is drunk.
